gates.question: Are all four views present, and is there a hole through a part?

report.note: deterministic; zero token; mandatory azimuth coverage catches off-axis-only defects, interior-hole flood fill catches silhouette-enclosed background that an area-only check misses

gates.question: What differs from the Turnaround inside the silhouette, banded by height?
Does a closed island of the mesh cross itself?
Is there enough geometry at each joint?

report.note: loops are counted as distinct vertex bands along the bone axis, not as recovered quad loops; a dense joint with only two bands still cannot bend and is reported as such

gates.question: Is each prop on the bone that the Unit Spec names?
Is each Body Region where the Unit Spec says?
Is each left and right pair a reflection, not a rotation?

report.note: A pair that is wrong the same way on both sides is still a mirror of itself.

gates.question: Is each region within delta-E 5 of the card painting?
Is every part of the Unit Spec present?
